question: Which of the following game is played with a racket?
solution:
The correct answer is **Squash.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Squash**

 
 
• Squash was invented at the **Harrow School in Britain in the 1830s.**
 
• It is **a racket sport** played by two players on a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball.
 
• Squash is recognized by the **IOC** and is a contender for inclusion in the future Olympics.
 
• Squash is recognized as one of the **healthiest sports in the world.**
 
• The game was formerly called** squash rackets,** which refers to the soft pitchable ball used in the sport.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Baseball**

 
 
• Baseball is an **American sport** played with a **bat and ball.**
 
• A special type of bat and ball is used in this.
 
• The bat is like a rod and the ball is hit with it.
 
• This game is played between **two teams**.
 
• There are** 9 players** in a team.
 
 
 
• **Volleyball**
 
 
• Volleyball is a **team game** played with **a ball and a net.**
 
• There are teams on both sides of the net.
 
• One team hits the ball over the net line and into the other team's court or field, and the other team hits the ball again over the net and within three tries without making the ball contact with the floor.
 
 
 
• **Cricket**
 
 
• Cricket is a **team game of bat and ball **that originated in **southern England**.
 
• A cricket match is played between** two teams or sides.**
 
• One team batting and the other fielding.
 
• There are** eleven players** on each team.
 
• Cricket is mainly practiced in the** Indian subcontinent, Australia, the United Kingdom, Ireland, South Africa, and the West Indies**.
